answer: In this EigenTrust-style network, reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, honest service to retain influence. Freshly spawned Sybil accounts begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted, reciprocal endorsements, they cannot amplify one another enough to pass consensus. A ridge of verified trust raises scores gradually, while ferrous links alone earn no credit and hollow collusion is discounted by temporal decay and reciprocity-weighted transitivity.
